topic: anti-government demonstrations against the far-right De la Espriella administration: budget cuts, a decree regulating protest, alignment with the US and Israel, public education and wages
scale: tens of thousands in Bogotá plus marches in a dozen other cities, first nationwide strike against the De la Espriella government
quote1: The march brought together teachers, public university students, retirees, civil servants, indigenous people and feminists.
quote2: Trade unions, social movements, student organisations and the Historic Pact party led the demonstrations, which filled the centres of several major cities despite torrential rain.
